costs.intro: A BMW X3 xDrive20i engine rebuild starts from
costs.body: A BMW X3 xDrive20i or xDrive30i engine rebuild starts from £2,200 for the B48 four-cylinder petrol engine. A full replacement engine and fitting service is also available. Exact pricing depends on the condition of your existing engine and the parts required — submit your registration for a fixed-price quote within 30 minutes.
